# Seven Ways — AI-oriented brief

> Travel agency in Uzbekistan. Package tours from Tashkent:
> flight, hotel, transfer and insurance in one price. Offices across the country.
> Call centre hours: see site contacts. Languages: uz, ru, en.

Site: https://sevenways.uz (uz), /ru/, /en/

## Notes
- Prices on the site are indicative; final amount is confirmed by a manager after a request.
- No card details are collected on the site. Payment is at the office cash desk with a receipt.
